Create Google Ads account at ads.google.com with the business email
Enter legal business name, site URL, billing, and set timezone to target market
Define the primary objective (leads / calls / sales) — drives campaign type & bidding
Link Google Ads to GA4, Search Console, and Google Business Profile
Review and disable unwanted auto-apply recommendation settings
Phase 2 — Conversion Tracking (do BEFORE any spend)
Set up Google Tag Manager for flexible tag deployment
Create conversion actions for real outcomes (form submit, call, purchase)
Place the conversion tag on thank-you / confirmation pages and verify it fires
Mark only true conversions as primary; set page views/time-on-site as secondary
Add server-side / enhanced conversions for post-cookie data accuracy
Confirm GA4 imports aren't double-counting with native Google Ads tags
Set account hierarchy: Account → Campaign → Ad Group → Keywords + Ads
Separate Brand, Non-Brand Search, and PMax into their own campaigns/budgets
Adopt a consistent naming convention (market | type | theme)
Build tight ad groups (5–20 closely related keywords, one theme each)
Start new keywords on Phrase & Exact match; reserve Broad for proven performers
Add 20+ negative keywords before launch; build shared negative lists
Write 2–3 Responsive Search Ads per ad group
Add all relevant assets/extensions (sitelinks, callouts, snippets, call, location)
Uncheck Display Network expansion on Search campaigns
Set location targeting to 'Presence' only (not presence-or-interest)
Set daily budget high enough to exit the learning phase and get real data
Start with Maximize Clicks/Conversions; move to Smart Bidding after 50+ conv/mo
Run pre-launch final check (tracking live, locations, budget, ads approved)
Enable campaign and monitor closely for the first 48–72 hours
Review Search Terms Report after first ~100 clicks; mine new negatives
Hold structural changes for 4–6 weeks so Smart Bidding can learn
Weekly budget review: spend pace, CPA trend, ROAS trajectory (trends not points)
Pause campaigns that spend 3–5× target CPA with zero conversions; audit fundamentals
Test new ad variations; trim underperforming keywords; reallocate to winners
Run a full Google Ads audit (tracking, structure, bidding, attribution)
Pick platforms by where the audience actually is (depth over breadth)
Create/claim business accounts: Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn
Apply consistent logo, colors, and profile/cover images at correct 2026 sizes
Write keyword-clear bios with a call to action and link on every profile
Set up Facebook/Instagram Shop & catalog (if product-based)
Connect Meta Business Suite and link Instagram to the Facebook page
Write a one-sentence brand positioning statement to guide every post
Create audience personas (roles, interests, challenges, content they engage)
Research 10–15 competitors per platform; note formats, cadence, gaps
Define 3–5 content pillars every post must map to
Set measurable 90-day goals (followers, engagement %, clicks, signups)
Build a content calendar with themes, campaigns, and key dates
Bank 15–20 posts before launch; schedule the first full week
Design 10+ reusable templates for recurring content types
Repurpose each core asset across formats (blog → carousel → Reel → Stories)
Reply to comments and DMs; engage in relevant groups/communities
Track trending audio/formats weekly and adapt before they fade
Set up Instagram Broadcast Channel for announcements (if relevant)
Install Meta Pixel / TikTok Pixel / LinkedIn Insight Tag and verify events
Build first-party custom audiences and lookalikes
Launch a test campaign per platform with a clear objective and small budget
A/B test creatives and audiences; scale winners, cut losers
Build a combined dashboard: paid spend/CPA/ROAS + social reach/engagement/clicks
Review platform analytics weekly; spot early trends before they snowball
Monthly performance review vs the 90-day goals; adjust the plan
Quarterly audit of profiles, ad accounts, and strategy; pivot what's flat
